title: Clear Skies, Silence, and the Director

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the academy grounds, I spotted a familiar figure.
...Class should still be in session, though...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey there.
Fancy meeting you here.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Vocal lessons.
Though being cooped up in a classroom just wasn't doing it for me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Got permission from the teacher,
so now I'm looking for a spot with better vibes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. is always true to herself.
I wonder what kind of place lifts her spirits...
choice_data_list: Mind if I tag along on your search?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Don't mind at all... but you sure take an interest in the weirdest things, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Cutting through the wind, breaking into a run~♪
My beating heart won't ever stoooop~♪
choice_data_list: Your voice carries really well here.
Your voice carries really well here.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeah, singing in a wide-open space feels good, but...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hmm, guess this isn't quite the spot!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Hrmmm, not here either, I guess.
Doesn't feel any different from singing in the classroom.
choice_data_list: Even a real stage isn't cutting it?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Asking me won't help much.
Even I don't really know what I'm looking for.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Just something more... mmph!
Oh well. On to the next one!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is what she's searching for really that elusive...?
Unable to fathom what went on inside her head, all I could do was follow along.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Mmm~ the breeze feels so good.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: And... yeah, this view!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Racing through at the speed of light, this impulse is—...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: A resolve of strength I'll make real, no matter what it costs!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeah, this is it! Right here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The rooftop... It offered an open sky and a sense of freedom,
but surrounded by wire fences, it hardly looked like a stage—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Take a look over there yourself.
A vast stage stretching as far as the eye can see.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
And look at the buildings reflecting the blue sky.
Every single one looks just like an audience waving penlights!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Plus, it comes with a spotlight courtesy of the sun!
See? It's the ultimate stage!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her words made it feel as though a stage had manifested right before my eyes.
The carefree way she sang up there seemed to prove her point—
choice_data_list: You're right, it really is a stage.
You're right, it really is a stage.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, right?
...Yup, alright. Think this will answer it?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Their true feelings, of course.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Our vocal coach puts their heart and soul into teaching us, after all.
You've gotta answer feelings with feelings.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Sure, it's not like I couldn't sing in a classroom, but...
I just really hated the idea. It felt dishonest.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Now I think I can finally head back—

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Hey, you! Who's up on the roof during class time?!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh, it's the hall monitor teacher...
Sorry! Explain things for me, will ya?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sticking out her tongue, Mr. C.B. slipped
nimbly past the hall monitor teacher.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She stayed true to herself just to give her absolute best performance.
I couldn't help but feel that was quintessential Mr. C.B.
